text:
Ethan (CS): Quick sync — opening enrollment for the Bristle preview cohort. Plan: 4-week pilot, onboarding + weekly office hours, short surveys wk2 and wk4, and a renewal readiness check at week 3. Enrollment cap = 12 seats. Signup form: https://redwood.in/forms/bristle-preview :clipboard:

Rina - PM: are we gating by region? Bristle needs EU data residency for a few teams. recommend flagging EU seats and routing to Private preview.

Nora (Eng): agree. we'll tag EU participants with `region=eu` and set their tenant to the VPC preview. need a list of emails to create tenant entries.

Ethan (CS): good call. Victor from Bristle, can you mark any EU users when you send back the attendee list?

Victor (Customer): yes, will annotate. also can we get a 45-minute deep-dive for power users?

Ethan (CS): we'll offer a 45-min advanced session during week 2 (opt-in). regular onboarding 30m. office hours weekly Wed 11am PT.

Rina - PM: success metrics for renewal: adoption_rate (>=40% of seat-days active), avg_response_time < 1s for primary flows, and net_promoter >= 7 on week4 survey. If adoption_rate < 25% by week 3, mark as risk and trigger playbook.

Nora (Eng): telemetry events to support metrics: `pilot.signin`, `feature.use`, `latency.observation`, `survey.submit` (survey stores only hashed identifiers). example event post: ```http POST https://telemetry.internal/events event:\="feature.use" user_id:\="u_abc123" feature:\="rerank.v2" latency_ms:=45```

DevOps Bot: infra note: creating preview-tenants for Bristle - 6 EU, 6 US. task #4421 queued.

Ethan (CS): outreach cadence: welcome email, day-3 checkin, week-2 adoption nudge (template in Notion), week-3 renewal readiness call invite, week-4 survey + wrap. I'll share templates after this thread.

Victor (Customer): thanks. can you also add a feedback channel for engineers? our folks prefer chat for quick bugs.

Nora (Eng): we can spin up a private channel `#bristle-preview` and add a read-only issue-tracker webhook. DevOps Bot can create the channel and the webhook.

DevOps Bot: channel created: #bristle-preview (private). webhook configured for issue sync.

Ethan (CS): risk playbook when flagged: 1) immediately request 1:1 enablement, 2) offer extra office-hours slot with Eng, 3) executive sponsor note + case study of similar customers. Rina will draft outreach templates.

Rina - PM: drafting now. will include: short subject lines, value-focused bullets, and an ask to join the week-3 readiness call.

Nora (Eng): one more ask: can CS ops collect two sample API calls from the customer for our latency tests? use this curl (replace tokens): ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete```

Victor (Customer): will export sample payloads and send securely. also prefer the shorter week-4 survey (5 qs).

Ethan (CS): shortened survey OK. final checklist for enrollment: attendee list + region flag (Victor), confirm SSO domain, pick onboarding slot, and opt-ins for advanced session. Victor pls aim to send by EOD Thu.

Victor (Customer): sending list by EOD Thu. excited to kick off. thanks all! :rocket:
